description: Helpers for tests invoking parallel-checkout in a Git environment, including configuration, testing worker processes, and verifying checkouts.

methods.name: set_checkout_config
methods.description: Sets global checkout configuration parameters for workers and parallelism threshold.

methods.name: test_checkout_workers
methods.description: Runs a command to verify the number of checkout worker threads used matches expectation.

methods.name: verify_checkout
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of a checkout by checking the git status and diff.
